ezekiel.7.p1.b1.text: O son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says to the land of Israel: ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.

ezekiel.7.p1.b2.text: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you … Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ezekiel.7.p1.b3.text: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. Behold, it has come!

ezekiel.7.p1.b4.text: Behold, the day is here! It has come! Doom has gone out, the rod has budded, arrogance has bloomed.

ezekiel.7.p1.b5.text: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn …

ezekiel.7.p1.b6.text: … The vision concerning the whole multitude will not be revoked, and because of their iniquity, not one of them will preserve his life.

ezekiel.7.p2.b1.text: They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.

ezekiel.7.p2.b2.text: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.

ezekiel.7.p2.b3.text: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem unclean.

ezekiel.7.p2.b4.text: … Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetites or fill their stomachs with wealth …

ezekiel.7.p2.b5.text: I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place. Violent men will enter it, and they will defile it.

ezekiel.7.p2.b6.text: Then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction from the priests will perish, as will counsel from the elders.

ezekiel.7.p2.b7.text: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. … Then they will know that I am the LORD.
